authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/novation/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/novation/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI parameter table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the guide prints no Device Inquiry reply.
Messages that carry several switches, each with values of its own, a choice each: NRPN 0:122, NRPN 1:123. CEditor does not attribute one of these to a parameter when the instrument sends it.
Left out, the performance controllers: MIDI Modulation (CC 1), MIDI Breath Controlller (CC 2), MIDI Expression Controller (CC 11), MIDI Sustain Pedal (CC 64).
Left out, MIDI's own controllers, which carry the NRPNs this profile sends: MIDI Data Entry MSB (CC 6), MIDI Data Entry LSB (CC 38), MIDI NPRN LSB (CC 98), MIDI NPRN MSB (CC 99).
Left out, a range that wraps past 127 (two's complement, 124 - 4): Voice KeyboardOctave (CC 13).
Left out, bank select: MIDI Bank LSB (CC 32).

Left out, a message another row already has: LFO2 OneShot (NRPN 0:122), LFO2 KeySync (NRPN 0:122), LFO2 CommonSync (NRPN 0:122), LFO2 DelayTrigger (NRPN 0:122), LFO2 FadeMode (NRPN 1:123), LFO3 OneShot (NRPN 0:122), LFO3 KeySync (NRPN 0:122), LFO3 CommonSync (NRPN 0:122), LFO3 DelayTrigger (NRPN 0:122), LFO3 FadeMode (NRPN 1:123), VocalTune Insert (NRPN 1:123).
Left out, printed without a control number: Gator Levels (NRPN 5:0-31), Vocoder SpectrumLevels (NRPN 6:0-31), Chorder Chorder Keys (NRPN 7:17-25).
Left out, printed without a range: Vocoder SpectrumResample (NRPN 6:32), MIDI All Sounds Off (CC 120), MIDI All Notes Off (CC 123).
Left out, a range of 40 - 240, wider than its message carries: MIDI Tempo Rate (NRPN 2:63).

103 choice(s), their names from the value tables the rows point to (Table 1: Waveform Table, Table 2: List of Modulation Destinations, Table 3: Sync Values, Table 4: Tweak Assignments) where a table numbers every value of the range, or from the rows' own notes.
